name: inline-citation
description: A paragraph that names its sources in the sentence: a hostname pill with +N sits where the claim is. Tap opens the source under the text; extra sources page one at a time. Never a footnote dump.
avoidWhen: Do not use for filters or actions; use chip or button. Do not use for a bibliography or a sources list under a message; this is for a claim inside running text.

ux.behaviour: The first source's hostname sits in the sentence as a quiet pill; extra sources collapse to +N on that pill, never as a list
ux.why: You can keep reading the claim and still see that it is sourced

ux.behaviour: The pill scales while pressed with a click haptic; the visual stays line-sized and the hit target is a min 48 dp box around that pill so hostname and +N are inside it
ux.why: A footnote-sized chip is unmissable to the eye and still hittable with a thumb
ux.reducedMotion: No scale; ripple and haptic only

ux.behaviour: Tap opens the current source under the paragraph, with title, url, and an Open source action; TalkBack reads Showing plus the title
ux.why: On a phone there is no hover, and covering the claim with a card makes you lose the sentence you just read

ux.behaviour: When more than one source is attached, Next and Previous page one source at a time with a tick haptic and a live 1 of N index
ux.why: Three sources should not become a wall of cards; you asked about this claim, not the whole bibliography
ux.reducedMotion: The next source appears without the fade

ux.behaviour: A second tap on the pill closes the card; the open source and page index survive rotation
ux.why: You are still in the paragraph; leaving the source should not throw you out of the text

aiHints: Put {cite} or [1] in the string where the pill should sit; if you omit a marker the pill is appended
Pass a list of AppCitation for one claim; extra items become +N, not extra pills
For two claims in one paragraph use [1] and [2] with the citations map overload, not two AppInlineCitation calls
Do not wrap this in a chip or a button; the pill is already the control
Pass onOpenUrl in tests or when you do not want LocalUriHandler; the Open source action is how the reader leaves to the page
expanded and expandedCitation seed rememberSaveable once for previews and tests; they are not a two-way binding
A [n] with no matching citations[n] stays as the characters [n]; it does not vanish

examples.title: Cite a claim in a sentence
examples.code:
AppInlineCitation(
    text = "Svelte offers better performance {cite} than older tools.",
    sources = listOf(
        AppCitation(url = "https://svelte.dev", title = "Svelte"),
        AppCitation(url = "https://kit.svelte.dev", title = "SvelteKit"),
    ),
)
